name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: M6.6 quake south-west of Tual, Indonesia, on 16 Nov rated PAGER green; no M7+ in seven days
state: USGS recorded an M6.6 earthquake 148km west-south-west of Tual, Indonesia, at 21:11 UTC on 16 Nov, rated PAGER green, the only M6+ event in the seven days to 18 Nov. M5.8 quakes near Ruteng, Indonesia, and off Madang, Papua New Guinea, on 18 Nov were also rated green (USGS). No M7+, PAGER orange alert or tsunami warning, so Normal holds.
for_you: No action needed. In quake-prone areas, follow local civil protection guidance.
rubric_hit: No M7+ or PAGER orange in 7 days = Normal

sources.title: USGS — M6.6, 148 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia

why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
